_comment: EXAMPLE presets.json — this file is NOT loaded by the mod (it loads presets.json, which ships empty).
Pick the skills you want from client/skill-list.json and paste them INTO presets.json as-is.
Full entries are fine: extra fields like type/desc are ignored — only name and id are read.
- Key = your exact character name (the dropdown lists whatever keys exist here).
- Value = list of skill entries. Each entry needs at least {name, id}; you may paste whole lines from skill-list.json unchanged.
- Order matters: entry N goes to hotbar slot 27+N-1 (ASDFGHJKL row). Put buff/heal skills first,
attack skills last. Max 9 usable slots; extra lines are ignored beyond the 9th, and any skill
your character hasn't learned is silently skipped by the server.
- "id": null means unresolved — those entries are skipped by the mod.
